pages.en:
Ming Kou Pao
27-6-16

Wicked detectives promoted to be military officers.
Last year a prominent revolutionary named Tseng
Da Pei 曾大培 was illegally arrested by Ling Sih Fung 林世豐
and other detectives of Chang Hsun's secret service with
the co-operation of the Settlement Police. Ling bribed certain
people to go to Court as witnesses but thanks to
the French Police, who produced certain evidence
which caused the American Assessors to refuse to hand
over the prisoner. A sentence of one year's
imprisonment was however passed on Tseng. The
Detectives who had charge of the case received a
reward of $3,000 (we learn that the wife of Ling
obtained the money personally from Chang Hsun).
Part of the reward was given to a certain detective
and to the teacher of a girl school who acted as a
spy. On the 25th a mandate was issued by the President
appointing Ling Sih Fung and others military officers.
This greatly astonished the local revolutionaries.
They held a meeting in Avenue Paul Brunat. Those present
expressed the opinion that though Republicans may be
offenders in a despotic country but not in the present
regime. They wondered why the detectives who caused
the arrest and imprisonment of Republicans should be
promoted military officers instead of being punished.
This shows that Li Yuen Hung disregards Republicanism
and his action is not much different from that of Yuan
Shih Kai. As a result they decided to ask the Parliamentarians
to forward an interpellation to the Government and ask
for the punishment of the detectives who bribed witnesses
in the Tsen Da Pei case.

Tsen Hua Sin Pao. The Shanghai Admiralty declared independence on the
afternoon of the 25th inst. but previous to this, the
prominent Republicans in Shanghai sent representatives
make arrangements with Admiral Lee Ting Sing and the
Commanders of the various warships. After the declaration
Admiral Lee sent to representatives to interview the
Republican leaders and despatched telegrams to the
independent provinces.
Generals Yang Sien Teh, Lui Yung Ziang, the Military
Commissioners of Sungkiang and Shanghai, Mr. Chow Chin Piao,
the Taoyin and Mr. Yang Toheng, the Commissioner of
Foreign Affairs, upon receiving the declaration of
independence from Admiral Lee Ting Sing, were alarmed
and wired to the Central Government asking for instructions.
The night before last General Yang called the
Commandant of the Shanghai Garrison and the Chief of the
Chinese Police to his yamen to discuss precautionary
measures. Director Li of the Kiangnan Arsenal received
an order from General Yang to take precautions.
Yesterday the Authorities here received telegrams
from the Central Government, Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang
and Marine Minister Liu Kwan Yung regarding the
independence of the Shanghai Admiralty but no definite
orders were given.

Kung Oo Sin Pao. The Szechuen merchants in Shanghai have received a
telegram from Chungking stating that despite the order
of the Central Government and the Provisional Government
of the Republicans to avoid trouble, the troops under
Cheng Yi, the Chiangchun of Szechuen, and General Chow 周駿
Tsing opened hostilities on the 23rd inst. about 30 li from
Chengtu. The fighting lasted several hours with the
result that several of Chen's men were killed and wounded
and several surrendered to Chow.
General Wong Ling Chi has come to Chow's assistance.
Chen is still in Chengtu. The recipients of the above telegram
have discontinued their relations with Szechuen.
pages.zh:
《民口报》
1916年6月27日

恶探升任军官。
去年，一位名叫曾大培的著名革命党人被林世丰及其他张勋秘密服务部门的侦探非法逮捕，并得到租界警方的配合。林贿赂某些人出庭作证，但得益于法国警方提供了某些证据，导致美国陪审官拒绝移交该囚犯。然而，曾仍被判处一年监禁。负责此案的侦探获得了3,000美元的奖励（我们获悉，林的妻子亲自从张勋处领取了这笔钱）。部分奖励分给了某位侦探以及一名充当间谍的女校教师。25日，总统发布命令，任命林世丰等人为军官。此举令当地革命党人大为震惊。他们在蒲石路举行会议。与会者表示，虽然共和派人士在专制国家可能是罪犯，但在现政权下并非如此。他们不解为何导致共和派人士被捕入狱的侦探不仅未受惩罚，反而被提拔为军官。这表明李元洪无视共和主义，其行为与袁世凯并无多大区别。因此，他们决定请求国会议员向政府提出质询，并要求惩办在曾大培案中贿赂证人的侦探。

《振华新报》。上海海军部于本月25日下午宣布独立，但在此之前，上海的著名共和派人士已派遣代表与李鼎新海军上将及各舰艇指挥官进行安排。宣布独立后，李上将派遣代表会见共和派领导人，并向独立各省发送电报。
杨善德将军、卢永祥将军（松江和上海镇守使）、周金彪先生（道尹）以及杨道衡先生（交涉员），在收到李鼎新海军上将的独立宣言后感到惊慌，致电中央政府请示指示。前晚，杨将军召集上海卫戍司令和华捕总监到其衙门讨论预防措施。江南制造局李总监接到杨将军的命令，要求采取预防措施。
昨日，本地当局收到来自中央政府、长江巡阅使冯国璋以及海军总长刘冠雄关于上海海军部独立的电报，但未给出明确指令。

《公论新报》。在沪四川商人收到来自重庆的电报，称尽管中央政府和共和派临时政府下令避免冲突，但四川督军陈毅和周骏将军的部队于本月23日在成都附近约30里处开战。战斗持续数小时，结果陈部多人死伤，多人向周投降。
王陵基将军已前来援助周。陈仍留在成都。上述电报的接收者已断绝与四川的联系。

pages.en:
Si Si Pao.
27-6-16.

2

There is a rumour in circulation in this city that
Zee Kuo Liang, the Chief of the Chinese Police here,
will be dismissed by the Government for having
neglected his duties in connection with the recent
shooting affray on North Szechuen Road
Extension. It is presumed that either Chuen Feng
Wu崔鳳舞, Chief of the Soochow Police, or Shum Yu沈瑜
Chief of the Shanghai-Nanking Railway's Police, will
be appointed to replace Zee.

Tsao Chia Ziang, the Vice-Minister of Marine, has
been requested to come to Shanghai immediately to
try the case against the officers on the cruiser Haiyung
which sunk the O.M. s.s Hsinyu. The trial will take
place before a special court, in the Admiralty House
at Nantao.

Tsang Ta Yen章太炎, the well-known scholar, who was
practically a prisoner in Peking since 1913, has
been restored to liberty and will leave the capital
for Chekiang shortly. Tutuh Li of Chekiang has
appointed an officer to welcome Mr. Tang. His
fellow countrymen in Shanghai will hold a reception
in his honour when he arrives in this port.
pages.zh:
《时事新报》。
1916年6月27日。

2

本市流传着一则谣言，称本地华捕总监张国良将因在北四川路延伸段最近的枪击事件中失职而被政府免职。据推测，苏州警察总监崔凤舞或沪宁铁路警察总监沈瑜将被任命接替张的职务。

海军次长曹嘉祥已被要求立即来上海，审理“海容”号巡洋舰击沉招商局轮船“新裕”号一案中涉事军官的案件。审判将在南市的 Admiralty House（海军部大楼）特别法庭进行。

著名学者章太炎自1913年以来实际上被囚禁在北京，现已恢复自由，并将不久离开首都前往浙江。浙江督军已指派一名官员迎接章先生。其在上海的同胞将在他抵达本埠时举行招待会以示欢迎。

pages.en:
Sin Wan Pao.
4-1-16.

With reference to a report in yesterday's issue
to the effect that Mr. McEuen, the Capt. Supt. of
S.M.P. has employed seven Intelligence Officers for
the special purpose of detecting and arresting brigands
and appointed D.S. 32 Givens as Officer in charge, we
further learn that Mr. McEuen has, in view of the
approach of the cold seasons, prepared certain strict
and satisfactory measures for policing the districts
but the report in yesterday's issue was not true.

Shunpao.

It was reported in yesterday's issue of this
paper that Tsen Da Fei 詹大非 and Wen Tsao Ying 温楚珩
would be tried at the Mixed Court at 2 p.m. to-day.
At 8 a.m. yesterday Mr. Musso, Counsel representing
the Chinese Government, Ling Sz Fung 林世豐, Chief
Intelligence Officer of the Yangtze Inspecting
Commissioner, and Wong Hai King 汪海棅, a deputy
from Hupeh, were at the office at the Mixed Court
where they questioned the two prisoners who were
brought here from Hupeh. They found that their
statements correspondent with those made in Hupeh.
Mr. Yung Tung Ts 楊潤之, a translator at the
Mixed Court translated the statements which he finished
at 12 noon.
In the afternoon the Chief Intelligence Officer
addressed a letter to Military Commissioner Yang 楊
requesting him to hand the prisoner Zung Hai 徐熙 who
had been brought here from Nanking to the Mixed Court
at 1 p.m. on the 4th to give evidence.

At 7 p.m. the night before last a man who gave
his name as Kau Zay 曹瑞, a staff officer to a
certain yamen, in company with 3 men, 2 of whom wore
yellow military uniform and the third dressed like
a servant, went to the Da Yu 大有 Oil Mill in Ichang
Road in a motor car & interviewed the manager Mr. Kau
Dih Chien 高狄錢. Kau said that owing to the change
in the form of government, Yunnan had declared its
independence and an expedition would be sent to attack
that province but owing to the lack of military funds
they were ordered to borrow several tens of thousands
of dollars from him to supply the troops. Mr. Kau
replied he did not have a large sum of money and there
was only about $120 in the safe which would do no
good. They said they would accept any amount. They
then wrote an I.O.U. paper for $100 and went away with
the money by the motor car towards Frenchtown. Later
Mr. Kau reported the matter to the Gordon Road Station
from whence detectives were sent out to make enquiries.
The latter found that the swindlers previous to the
commission of the crime, went to the Mang Yue Hotel
Hupeh Road where they ordered a room and paid one
dollar in advance. They sent a waiter to call a motor
car by which they all left and have not returned since.
The detectives reported this to the Inspector and the
latter, considering that it is a case of false pretences
by persons representing themselves to be officials,
reported the case to Mr. McEuen, the C.S.P. with a
request that the detectives of all Stations be instructed
to trace the responsible offenders.

National Herald.

The corpse of an unknown female aged about 50 was
found the day before yesterday on a lonely place off
Ichang Road. There were several knife wounds on the
body. The matter was reported to the Gordon Road Station
by a pedestrian. The Inspector and the Chinese detectives
went to the scene and saw the corpse which was covered
with blood. The only clothes on the corpse was an inner
vest. The woman must have been murdered by someone. The
body was removed to the Pearon Road Mortuary for an inquest.
pages.zh:
《新闻报》。
1916年1月4日。

关于昨日报道中提及工部局警务处总监麦尤恩先生雇佣七名情报员专门用于侦缉和逮捕匪徒，并任命副巡官32号吉文斯为负责人的消息，我们进一步获悉，鉴于寒冷季节临近，麦尤恩先生已为各区治安准备了某些严格且令人满意的措施，但昨日报纸的报道并不属实。

《申报》。

本报昨日报道，詹大悲和温楚珩将于今日下午2点在混合法庭受审。
昨日上午8时，代表中国政府的律师穆索先生、长江巡阅使首席情报官林世丰以及湖北代表汪海棅来到混合法庭办公室，审讯了两名从湖北带来的囚犯。发现他们的供词与在湖北所作的供词相符。
混合法庭翻译杨润之先生翻译了这些供词，于中午12时完成。
下午，首席情报官致函杨镇守使，请求他将刚从南京带来的囚犯徐熙于4日下午1点送至混合法庭作证。

前晚7时，一名自称曹瑞的男子，系某衙门参谋，与另外三人同行，其中两人身穿黄色军装，第三人装扮如仆人，乘坐汽车前往宜昌路的大有油厂，会见经理高狄钱先生。曹称，由于政体变更，云南已宣布独立，将派遣远征军攻打该省，但因缺乏军费，奉命向他借款数万美元以供应军队。高先生回答说他并没有大额资金，保险柜里只有约120美元，无济于事。他们说任何金额都可以接受。随后，他们写了一张100美元的借据，拿着钱乘汽车向法租界方向离去。后来，高先生将此事项戈登路巡捕房报告，巡捕房随即派出侦探进行调查。后者发现，诈骗犯在作案前曾前往湖北路的孟悦旅馆，预订了一个房间并预付了一美元。他们派侍者叫了一辆汽车，随后全部离开，至今未归。侦探将此情况报告给督察，督察认为这是一起冒充官员进行诈骗的案件，遂向警务处总监麦尤恩先生报告，并请求指令各巡捕房的侦探追踪 Responsible offenders（责任罪犯）。

《国民公报》。

前天，在宜昌路附近一处偏僻地方发现一具约50岁的无名女尸。身上有多处刀伤。一名路人将此事项戈登路巡捕房报告。督察和华捕侦探赶赴现场，看到尸体血迹斑斑。尸体上仅穿一件内衣。该女子必是被他人谋杀。尸体已被移至倍开尔路验尸所进行验尸。

31-12-15

Yesterday, Mr. Ling Sz Foong 林世豐 the Chief of the
Intelligence Office of the Yangtse Inspecting Commissioner
called at the Bureau of Foreign Affairs where he, Mr. Chow
the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs, Mr. Wong Soong Sung,

Body to hold special hearings on Wednesday and Thursday next.

....................

1915年12月31日

pages.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 149
Date
December 28th 1915

Sir,
As the result of the killing of one Japanese and the wounding of another on board the British steamer Hsin Ming 新明 lying at a jetty in Nantao on the evening of February 5th 1914 an office which had been established at No.835 Burkill Road was raided.
The official seal was seized, together with several bundles of documents of a secret and confidential nature which proved the existence of a Chinese Intelligence Bureau and Detective Department with a strength at the beginning of the year of fifteen intelligence officers and detectives costing the Chinese Government, according to the statement of accounts, the sum of $1513.40 for the month of January alone. None of the staff were present when the raid was made and no arrests were effected.
The official in charge bore the name of Ling Wei Sun林蔚生alias Ling Sz Foong 林世豐. He was responsible to General Chang Hsun張勳 at Hsuchowfu 徐州府.
He fled from Shanghai at the time his Bureau was raided.
In October 1914 the Warrant which was issued against him in connection with the murder of the Japanese was cancelled, the Japanese Consulate having intimated to the Mixed Court that they had no objection as far as the charge against Ling Sz Foong and his two subordinates of being concerned in the murder of a Japanese was concerned.
With the functioning of these officials in the Settlements, the Japanese Consulate informed us they had nothing to do and it is intimated in the Captain Superintendent's report published in the Budget for 1915 that the charge of improper functioning still holds good.
In addition to information which the Police have received the attached newspaper extracts show that Ling has again returned from the north and that he is again functioning in Shanghai. He lives in a house at No.1 Ling Ying Road林蔭 where he has a guard of four soldiers.
The attached report from D.I. Fitzgibbon indicates clearly that there is a connection with Mr.Yang of the Mixed Court and the Intelligence Department of General Chang Hsun 張勳.

Your Obedient Servant,
minnnnnnshong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

刑事侦缉处
情报登记
第 149 号
日期
1915年12月28日

先生：

鉴于1914年2月5日晚，停泊在南市码头的一艘英国轮船“新明”号（Hsin Ming）上发生一名日本人死亡、另一名日本人受伤的案件，警方对位于伯基路（Burkill Road）835号的一处办公地点进行了突击搜查。

行动中查获了官方印章，以及数捆具有秘密和机密性质的文件，这些文件证实存在一个中国情报局和侦探部门。据账目陈述，该部门年初拥有十五名情报官员和侦探，仅一月份就花费中国政府1513.40美元。突击搜查时，没有任何工作人员在场，也未实施逮捕。

负责人名为林蔚生（Ling Wei Sun），别名林世豐（Ling Sz Foong）。他向驻徐州府（Hsuchowfu）的张勳将军负责。

在其情报局被搜查时，他逃离了上海。

1914年10月，因涉及谋杀日本人一案对他签发的逮捕令被撤销，因为日本领事馆已向会审公廨表示，就林世豐及其两名下属涉嫌谋杀日本人的指控而言，他们并无异议。

随着这些人员在租界内的活动，日本领事馆告知我方他们与此无关；且在发表于1915年预算报告中的警务总监报告中暗示，关于其不当履职的指控仍然成立。

除了警方收到的情报外，随附的报纸摘录显示，林氏已从北方返回，并再次在上海活动。他居住在林蔭路（Ling Ying Road）1号的一所房屋内，并有四名士兵担任警卫。

随附的菲茨吉本（Fitzgibbon）侦探督察的报告清楚地表明，会审公廨的杨先生与张勳将军的情报部门之间存在联系。

您顺从的仆人，
minnnnnnshong
首席侦探督察。

致警务总监。

pages.en:
The following are extracts from the Chinese press
concerning Ling Sz Foong 林世豐:-

Ae Kou Pao 29/10/15.

Ling Wei Sun 林蔚生 son-in-law of General Chang
Hsun 張勳 has, since his appointment as Chief Intelligence
Officer in Shanghai, victimised many innocent people.
He has established an office in Ling Yen 林蔭路 Road
outside the West Gate and employed loafers as his
assistants. Taking advantage of the situation
caused by the monarchical movement, he falsely
reported to Chang Hsun 張勳 the arrivals of Rebel
in Shanghai and to ensure their apprehension, requested
the transmission of a big sum of money in order to meet
the expenses.
General Chang had great belief in his words and
sent to Shanghai $50,000. On account of the prevalent
rumours, Ling became frightened, he asked for police
protection but was refused. So he has removed to
the Settlement for shelter. How timid is the
Intelligence Officer? but he is paid $2,000 a month.

Shunpao 30-11-15

The day before yesterday Detective Ling Sz Foong 林世豐
of the Inspecting Commissioner of Yangtse 長江巡閱使
with the assistance of the Chapel Police arrested two
men named Wong Ching Foo 王金富 and Zee Poh Sung 徐福生
in Tien Pao Lee 天保里 Chapel who were wanted for
robbery in the Yien Zung Hsien district 鹽城 Kuangpeh
They alleged robbers are now detained in the Chapel
Police Court pending trial.

Sin Wan Pao 18-12-15

On the night of the 16th Military Commissioner Yang 楊
Military Councillor Yang 楊 and Taoyin Chou 周 received
a telegram from General Chang Hsun 張勳 stating that he
had received the following telegraphic report from
Chief Intelligence Officer Ling Sz Foong 林世豐
attached to Shanghai:-
"The rebels in Shanghai are plotting to do harm
to the country and the people. Tsen Ta Bas 詹大些
alias Tsen Tseh Zung 詹策宗 who was appointed Commander
in chief of Shanghai by Sun Wen 孫文 at the time of the
Second Revolution, and Wen Tso Heng 溫楚衡 alias Wong
Yang Ngoo 王養吾 alias Ma Vung Ching 馬文卿 both of whom
are badly wanted by the Central Government, resided at
547 South Chengtu Road. They took part in the recent rising.
At 6 a.m. to-day I (the Intelligence Officer) on information
received went to the above address with my own detectives
and the detectives of the Municipal Police, and succeeded
in arresting the two rebels. They found pistols and
revolutionary papers. Both prisoners were taken to the
Police Station for preliminary trial, etc".
General Chang adds that as the two Rebels have
been arrested, a request should be made to effect an
earlier extradition of the prisoners.

Sin Wan Pao. 20-12-15

Yesterday the Intelligence in charge of the
Secret Service of General Chang Hsun 張勳 the
Inspecting Commissioner of Yangtse, wrote to Military
Governor Yang to the effect that owing to the important
arrests he recently made, he feared revenge on the part of
the rebels, he therefore requested that soldiers be sent to his
office on guard duty so as to prevent any untoward incidents.
pages.zh:
以下是中文报刊关于林世豐（Ling Sz Foong）的摘录：-

《申报》 1915年10月29日。

张勳将军的女婿林蔚生，自被任命为上海首席情报官以来，迫害了许多无辜百姓。他在西门外的林蔭路设立了一处办公室，并雇佣游手好闲之徒作为助手。他利用帝制运动造成的局势，向张勳虚假报告革命党人抵达上海的情况，并要求汇寄巨款以确保将其逮捕，以此应付开支。

张勳将军深信其言，向上海汇款五万元。由于谣言四起，林氏感到恐惧，请求警方保护但被拒绝。因此他搬入租界寻求庇护。这位情报官是何等胆小？但他每月薪俸高达两千元。

《顺天时报》 1915年11月30日

前天，长江巡阅使署的侦探林世豐在捕房警方的协助下，在天保里（Tien Pao Lee）捕房辖区逮捕了两名男子，分别名为王金富（Wong Ching Foo）和徐福生（Zee Poh Sung），此二人因在广北盐城（Kuangpeh Yien Zung Hsien district）地区犯有抢劫罪而被通缉。据称，这两名强盗目前被拘押在捕房法庭，等待审判。

《新闻报》 1915年12月18日

16日晚，杨军事长官、杨军事参议和周道尹收到张勳将军发来的电报，称他收到了附在上海的首席情报官林世豐发来的以下电报报告：

“上海的革命党人正密谋危害国家和人民。詹大些（Tsen Ta Bas），别名詹策宗（Tsen Tseh Zung），曾在二次革命期间被孙文任命为上海总司令；温楚衡（Wen Tso Heng），别名王养吾（Wong Yang Ngoo），别名马文卿（Ma Vung Ching），此二人均被中央政府严加通缉，居住在成都南路547号。他们参与了最近的起义。今天上午6时，我（情报官）根据获得的情报，率领我自己的侦探以及工部局警务处的侦探前往上述地址，成功逮捕了这两名革命党人。现场搜出手枪和革命文件。两名囚犯已被带往警察局进行初步审讯等。”

张勳将军补充说，既然两名革命党人已被逮捕，应要求尽早引渡囚犯。

《新闻报》 1915年12月20日

昨日，负责长江巡阅使张勳将军秘密服务的情报主管致函杨军事长官，大意是鉴于他最近实施了重要逮捕，担心遭到革命党人的报复，因此请求派士兵到他的办公室执行警卫任务，以防止发生意外事件。

Form 2 / 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sinsa Station.
December 28 th 1915
REPORT ON Further report on the two Hsuchowfu Detectives.
Made by Det.Insr.Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by
Sir,
My reasons for stating that Ling Su
Foong is Secretary Yang's bosom companion are as follows :-
That Yang was the intermediary between us & the two alleged
Hsuchowfu Detectives who have since turned out to be Ling Su
Foong's assistants - the informants in the Bank Note, the Tse
Dah Dah & Moh Tung Hai cases. Upon going into this matter
lately I asked how it was that these men approached us through
Yang, other detectives beyond Settlement limits usually coming
to the Charge Room, C.D.S.NO 22 Soong Yoong Tsoong told me
that Yang & Ling Su Foong were NO 1 friends.C'D.C. NO 78 Wah
Ching Foh made a similar statement & under these circumstances
I believe that the two men in question are as I have said.
Soong Yoong Tsoong's Ex.second Yang Ah Ooh who has been employed
as a Detective by the new Commissioner for Foreign Affairs
since that gentleman resumed office has now reported to C.D.S
NO 22 that Yang & Ling Su Foong have met on two or three
occasions between 5 & 8 p.m. during the past week at NO 122
Bubbling Well Road which the C.D.S. says is a fact that confirms
the opinion he has already formed of these two persons.
Beyond these circumstances we have no actual proof that these
two men were seen together outside.
Yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon.
Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.

上海工部局警务处。
新闸捕房。
1915年12月28日
关于两名徐州侦探的进一步报告。
由菲茨吉本侦探督察撰写。转呈

先生：

我断言林世豐（Ling Su Foong）是杨秘书的心腹亲信，理由如下：

杨氏是我们与两名所谓的徐州侦探之间的中间人，而这两人后来被证实是林世豐的助手——即在假钞案、詹大悲（Tse Dah Dah）及马东海（Moh Tung Hai）案件中的线人。最近调查此事时，我曾询问为何这些人通过杨氏与我们接触，因为租界界限以外的其他侦探通常会直接来到中央侦探社（C.D.S.）的接待室。中央侦探社第22号宋永松（Soong Yoong Tsoong）告诉我，杨氏和林世豐是头号好友。中央侦探社第78号华清发（Wah Ching Foh）也作了类似陈述。在这种情况下，我相信我所提及的这两人正如我所说的那样。

宋永松的前任二号人物杨阿虎（Yang Ah Ooh），自那位绅士复职以来一直被新任外交专员雇佣为侦探，现已向中央侦探社第22号报告，杨氏和林世豐在过去一周内曾于下午5点至8点之间在南京路122号会面两三次，中央侦探社称这一事实证实了他对这两人已形成的看法。

除这些情况外，我们没有实际证据证明这两人在外面曾被看到在一起。

您顺从的，
莫里斯·菲茨吉本
侦探督察。
致首席侦探督察。

Form 2 . 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
SINZA Station.
December 23 rd 191 5.

REPORT ON Two Hsuchowfu Detectives.

Made by Det. Insp. Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by

Sir,
While at Mixed Court on 4 th October last
re- the Mau Tien 毛天 case, Secretary Yang said he wanted to
speak with me in his Office whither I was conducted & intro-
duced to two individuals that afterwards gave their names as
Ling Chee Foo 林軒甫 & Kos Vung Zu 柯鳳池 the secretary
stating they were Hsuchowfu Detectives who told me they xxxxxxx
knew where certain forged Bank Notes were being manufactured
in Sinza District. The two men accompanied me to Sinza Station
from where a raid was made on 528 Myburgh Road that day.
One of these men turned up at Sinza Station about 9.30 p.m. on
15 th instant with a Note from Secretary Yang, since destroyed,
stating that bearer wished to talk with me on an important
matter, the visitor on this occasion giving his name as Ling Moh
Voh 亦馬月 wrote down the names of two men-Tse Dah Bnk Peh 詹大悲
& Meh Tung Hai 馬東海-living in Sinza District wanted for
forging Bank Notes. It was found that the first man was wanted
on two Warrants for being concerned in the manufacture of
spurious Bank Notes. A Third Warrant charging him with being
a Revolutionist was found after the two others had been executed.
We had no Warrant for Moh Tung Hai.
The Hsuchowfu Detective took us to 547 South Chengtuh Road on
the
16 th inst the two men being subsequently arrested & at instance
of the Detective, Meh Tung Hai 馬東海 was also charged with forging
Bank Notes.

表格 2 . 34
上海工部局警务处。
新闸捕房。
1915年12月23日。

关于两名徐州侦探的报告。

由菲茨吉本侦探督察撰写。转呈

先生：

去年10月4日，我在会审公廨处理毛天（Mau Tien）一案时，杨秘书说他想在他的办公室与我谈话，我便随他前往，并被介绍给两个人，他们随后自称林軒甫（Ling Chee Foo）和柯鳳池（Kos Vung Zu）。秘书称他们是徐州侦探，他们告诉我他们 xxxxxxx 知道在新闸区制造某些伪造钞票的地方。这两人陪同我前往新闸捕房，当天对迈尔西爱路（Myburgh Road）528号进行了突击搜查。

本月15日晚上9点半左右，其中一人带着杨秘书的一张便条出现在新闸捕房，该便条随后被销毁，称持条人希望就重要事项与我交谈。此次来访者自称林亦馬月（Ling Moh Voh），写下了两名居住在新闸区、因伪造钞票而被通缉的人的名字——詹大悲（Tse Dah Bnk Peh）和马东海（Meh Tung Hai）。经查，第一人因参与制造假钞而在两张逮捕令中被通缉。在执行前两张逮捕令后，又发现了第三张指控其为革命党的逮捕令。我们并没有针对马东海的逮捕令。

本月16日，这名徐州侦探带我们去了成都南路547号，随后这两人被捕。在该侦探的要求下，马东海（Meh Tung Hai）也被指控伪造钞票。

WA
Ling Chee Foo, Alais Ling Moh Yoh, is said to be a Nephew of Ling
Su Foong 林世豐 who is already wanted by us for functionning.
The latter, Secretary Yang's bosom companion, is said to be the
head of the secret service branch in Shanghai under Chang Shun -
Inspector General of the Yangtse Forces. The Nephew & Koo
Vung Zu occupying subordinate positions.
I am told that LING SU FOONG who lives near the West gate visits
the Settlement occasionally.
We are endeavouring to effect his arrest.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.

林軒甫（Ling Chee Foo），别名林亦馬月（Ling Moh Yoh），据说是林世豐（Ling Su Foong）的侄子，林世豐已因非法活动被我方通缉。后者，即杨秘书的心腹亲信，据说是张勋（Chang Shun，即张勳）——长江部队巡阅使——在上海的秘密服务分支的头目。其侄子和柯鳳池（Koo Vung Zu）担任下级职务。

我获悉，住在西门附近的林世豐偶尔会进入租界。

您顺从的，

侦探督察。
